name: Intec Capital Limited
summary: Intec Capital Limited functions as a non-banking financial company (NBFC) primarily focused on providing credit solutions to Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs). The firm's offerings include a variety of loan products, such as general business financing and loans secured by collateral. Sanjeev Goel established the company on February 15, 1994, and it is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
